idea-plugin.name: LexiMeet
idea-plugin.description:
Meet vocabulary while reading code. LexiMeet connects to a compatible LexiMeet Desktop app and shows matching words in a tool window at the bottom of your IDE.

  • Find study and saved words in the Project view, open code, and JAR contents including decompiled sources.
  • Search, filter, and sort matches. Select a word to open its card and jump to an occurrence.
  • Look up definitions, pronunciation, and learning notes. Persistent highlighting is optional and off by default.

Requires LexiMeet Desktop with IDEA integration. The read-only connection uses a local Unix domain socket on macOS and Linux.

在读代码时遇见单词。连接词遇桌面端后，IDEA 底部词遇工具窗自动刷新匹配。

  • 在项目树、已打开的代码、JAR 文本和反编译文档中标记词库词汇。
  • 按单词、出处、学习状态或标签筛选，点击列名排序，单击单词定位并打开右侧词卡。
  • 悬浮查看桌面词库中的释义、音标、学习状态和个人笔记。

阅读功能需要配套的词遇桌面端。当前通过 macOS 和 Linux 的本机只读连接读取词库。
idea-plugin.change-notes: Initial release: Desktop discovery and pairing, a searchable word list and word cards, navigation to matches, and optional persistent highlighting.
